changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN escrow_deduction_pct numeric(5, 2), ADD COLUMN escrow_applies_to varchar(16), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_escrow_terms CHECK ((escrow_deduction_pct IS NULL) = (escrow_applies_to IS NULL) AND (escrow_applies_to IS NULL OR escrow_applies_to IN ('AMOUNT_PAID', 'TOTAL_PRICE'))); COMMENT ON COLUMN transactions.escrow_deduction_pct IS 'The refund deduction the buyer was offered, copied when an instalment purchase opened: the developer''s escrow share (on the land price for TOTAL_PRICE). Null: everything is held until the plan completes.';
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE transactions DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_escrow_terms, DROP COLUMN escrow_applies_to, DROP COLUMN escrow_deduction_pct;
